title: Advanced Passives
completion_message: ¡Excelente! Has dominado las 'Advanced Passives'. Usar estructuras como 'It is reported that...' o 'He is believed to be...' te permite comunicar información objetiva y profesional, ocultando al sujeto para mantener la diplomacia en los negocios.

parts.visual:
En nivel C1, usamos la Voz Pasiva Impersonal para reportar hechos, rumores o creencias sin decir quién lo dijo, ideal para periodismo o informes corporativos. 
Estructura 1 (It + passive + that clause): 
- Activa: People say that the company is bankrupt. 
- Pasiva: IT IS SAID THAT the company is bankrupt. 
- Activa: Experts expect that profits will fall. 
- Pasiva: IT IS EXPECTED THAT profits will fall.
parts.audio: At the C1 level, we use the Impersonal Passive Voice to report facts, rumors, or beliefs without saying who said them. This is ideal for journalism or corporate reports. Structure 1 uses 'It' plus a passive reporting verb plus a 'that' clause. Active sentence: People say that the company is bankrupt. Passive C1 version: It is said that the company is bankrupt. Active: Experts expect that profits will fall. Passive: It is expected that profits will fall.

parts.visual:
Estructura 2 (Sujeto + passive + to infinitive): 
Es aún más formal que la Estructura 1. Se enfoca directamente en la persona o cosa de la que se habla. 
- Activa: People say that the CEO is resigning. 
- Pasiva (Estructura 1): It is said that the CEO is resigning. 
- Pasiva (Estructura 2): THE CEO IS SAID TO BE resigning. 
- Activa: They report that the merger has failed. 
- Pasiva: THE MERGER IS REPORTED TO HAVE FAILED.
parts.audio: Structure 2 uses the Subject plus a passive verb plus a 'to' infinitive. This is even more formal than Structure 1. Active sentence: People say that the CEO is resigning. Structure 1: It is said that the CEO is resigning. Structure 2: The CEO is said to be resigning. Another example. Active: They report that the merger has failed. Passive Structure 2: The merger is reported to have failed.

stages.title: Interactive Quiz
stages.description: Elige la estructura de voz pasiva avanzada correcta.

questions.question: People say that he is a millionaire. -> ____ is said that he is a millionaire.
questions.explanation: Estructura impersonal: It is said that...

questions.question: People say that he is a millionaire. -> He is said ____ a millionaire.
questions.explanation: Estructura sujeto + pasiva + infinitivo: He is said to be...

questions.question: Journalists report that the bank lost $1 billion. -> ____ is reported that the bank lost $1 billion.
Journalists report that the bank lost $1 billion. -> The bank is reported ____ $1 billion.
questions.explanation: Acción pasada (lost): to have + participio (to have lost).

questions.question: Experts expect that the economy will recover next year. -> ____ is expected that the economy will recover.
Experts expect that the economy will recover next year. -> The economy is expected ____ next year.
They believe that the CEO stole the money. -> The CEO is believed ____ the money.
questions.explanation: Acción en el pasado (stole): to have stolen (Perfect Infinitive).

questions.question: Many think that the project is a disaster. -> ____ is thought that the project is a disaster.
Many think that the project is a disaster. -> The project is thought ____ a disaster.
Police know that the hackers are operating from Russia. -> The hackers are known ____ from Russia.
questions.explanation: Acción en progreso (are operating): Continuous Infinitive (to be operating).

questions.question: We estimate that 500 people will attend. -> ____ is estimated that 500 people will attend.
We estimate that 500 people will attend. -> 500 people are estimated ____.
Rumors say that the company is being sold. -> The company is rumored ____ sold.
questions.explanation: Voz pasiva continua (is being sold): to be being sold.

questions.question: People consider him to be the best leader. -> He is considered ____ the best leader.
They alleged that she forged the signature. -> She was alleged ____ the signature.
It ____ that the new model will cost $1000. (Se espera).
The suspect is known ____ a criminal record. (Tener).
questions.explanation: is known to have (se sabe que tiene).

questions.question: It is widely ____ that climate change is accelerating. (Creído / Se cree).
The virus is thought ____ originally in Asia. (Haberse originado).
The building is reported ____ severely damaged in the earthquake. (Haber sido).
questions.explanation: Pasado pasivo (was damaged): to have been damaged.

stages.title: Written Expression
stages.description: Escribe las palabras faltantes en la estructura pasiva.

questions.question: ____ is said that he is rich. (Se dice que...)
He is said ____ ____ rich. (Ser - 2 palabras)
____ is reported that the company failed. (Se reporta que...)
The company is reported ____ ____ failed. (Haber fallado - 2 palabras)
____ is expected that profits will rise. (Se espera que...)
Profits are expected ____ rise. (Subir - 1 palabra)
____ is known that she lied. (Se sabe que...)
She is known ____ ____ lied. (Haber mentido - 2 palabras)
The CEO is believed ____ ____ resigning. (Estar renunciando - 2 palabras)
____ is thought that they won. (Se piensa que...)

pairs.source: The bank is reported to have lost...
pairs.target: Se reporta que el banco ha perdido...
Se espera que las ganancias caigan...

pairs.source: She is believed to have stolen...
pairs.target: Se cree que ella ha robado...

pairs.source: They are thought to be operating...
